Name: Immersive Lighting
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
[size=5][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/sdnJ4DDK/immersive-lighting.png[/img][/center][center]
Stardew Valley's lighting can switch abruptly at certain times of day. Immersive Lighting smooths out those transitions so the changes happen gradually.[/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/7xnKZGy9/ezgif-com-animated-gif-maker-2.gif[/img]
At sunrise and sunset, light rays appear in the sky and fade out as time passes.
  [/center][/size][center][size=5][youtube]sgeD28eufeE[/youtube]

In interiors, lighting follows the outdoors, shadows get deeper as it gets darker outside, and brightness adjusts over time.

[youtube]CryiW_Xn5r4[/youtube]

The mod also includes new window sprites for interiors that change according to the time of day, to make it more natural to move between indoors and outdoors without noticeable lighting differences.[/size][size=5]

[/size][youtube]lYbXOsaJzcg[/youtube][size=5] 
  ﻿
This mod was made with much care and is the result of months of work. I made it to be as vanilla-friendly as possible. A huge thanks to my friend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Vlgor]Vlgor[/url]﻿ for helping me with suggestions and the window sprites![/size][/center]

Manifest.Name: Immersive Lighting
Manifest.Description: Adds smoother day-night transitions with realistic sunrise and sunset, improved lighting, and a more natural atmosphere.
Manifest.Author: Kanadeyoru
